text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka continues preparing for the Yayoi Sho as winter grows colder. One day, Special Week asks her to train together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka happily obliges. Seeing how hard Special Week works to improve makes her realize that other Umamusume run because they want to fulfill their dreams.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This discovery unsettles her, and she begins to doubt her reasons for running.
